Name: PetFrenzy
Description: Animated Eorzea Tamagotchi companion for FFXIV with Live Multiplayer & 8-Player Co-op Mini-Bosses! Punchline: Animated Eorzea Tamagotchi with Live Multiplayer, 8-Player Co-op Mini-Bosses, Deviruchi, Job weapons & Wardrobe!
